fullContent:
Maha Triphala Ghrita 
 Reference – Bhaishajyaratnavali Kushta Adhikara 
 Introduction 
 Maha triphaladya ghrita is a polyherbal ayurvedic formulation. In this formulation ghee is used as a base. This formulation known to contain properties such as cardioprotective, anti-diabetic, anti-obesity, anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial rejuvenating, adaptogenic, anti-oxidant and neuroprotective activities. This is very helpful to treat problems related with eyes. 
 Ingredients 
 768 ml of each of 
 
 Ghrita – Ghee 
 Water decoction of Triphala (Known to contain following three herbs – Haritaki – Terminalia chebula, Bibhitaki – Terminalia bellirica, Amla – Emblica officinalis 
 Bhringaraja swarasa – Juice extract of Eclipta alba 
 Vrisha rasa – Juice extract of Adhatoda vasica 
 Shatavari – Asparagus racemosus 
 Ajakshira – Goat milk 
 Guduchi rasa – Juice extract of Tinospora cordifolia 
 Amalaki Rasa – Juice extract of Emblica officinalis 
 
 8.72 g of each of 
 
 Kana – Long pepper 
 Sita – Sugar 
 Draksha – Raisins 
 Triphala (Haritaki – Terminalia chebula, Bibhitaki – Terminalia bellirica, Amla – Emblica officinalis) 
 Utpala – Nymphea stellata 
 Madhuka – Licorice 
 Kshirakakoli – Roscoea purpurea 
 Madhuparni – Tinospora cordifolia 
 Nidigdika – Solanum xanthocarpum 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 
 Take above ingredients and combine in a container. 
 The combination is heated till herbal ghee is prepared. 
 
 Dose 
 Quarter to half teaspoon, one to two times a day, with water during bed time. 
 Indications 
 
 Conjunctivitis 
 Dry eye 
 Glaucoma 
 Weak vision 
 Myopia 
 Hypermetropia 
 Eye pain 
 
 Contraindications 
 Take precautions if suffering from diabetes, high BP and heart diseases. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
